out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at BACK handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC ADDED TOWELS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE SINKS ARE ALWAYS PROPERLY SUPPLIED. SZECHUAN DELIGHT (Inspection Date: 08/05/2026) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED BACK HANDWASHING SINK WITH GLOVES IN THE SINK BASIN.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS PROVIDED GUIDANCE. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE ALWAYS ACCESSIBLE AND ARE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. OBSERVED FRONT HANDWASHING SINK WITHOUT SIGNAGE.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS WILL SEND PIC A COPY OF SIGNAGE THAT MAY BE POSTED; PLEASE POST SIGNAGE AT THIS SINK AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW SHELLED EGGS STORED OVER CARROTS IN THE WALK-IN COOLER.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS IN THE COOLER AND PROPER RAW ORGANIZATION WAS DISCUSSED.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food is not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: OBSERVED FRIED CHICKEN IN THE WALK-IN COOLER AT 77-89F MADE APPROXIMATELY 3 HOURS PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EHS PROVIDED EDUCATION AND PIC DISCARDED OF FOOD. PLEASE ENSURE COOLING FOODS ARE NOT WRAPPED WITH PLASTIC/LIDS UNTIL IT IS FULLY COOLED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food items were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED CUT CABBAGE AT 53F IN THE 2-DOOR PREP TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED FOOD ITEMS DURING INSPECTION TO ANOTHER COOLER. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL COLD HOLDING FOODS SHOULD BE KEPT AT 41F OR BELOW AT ALL TIMES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator. OBSERVED A CAN OF RAID IN THE ESTABLISHMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC DISCARDED OF RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL. PIC PROVIDED EHS WITH PEST CONTROL INVOICES. PLEASE ENSURE RESIDENTIAL PEST CONTROL IS NOT USED IN THE ESTABLISHMENT.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: FROZEN SHRIMP THAWING NEXT TO THREE-VAT SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER THAWING METHODS. SHRIMP WAS MOVED TO THE WALK-IN COOLER TO THAW.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED RICE SCOOPS IN AMBIENT TEMPERATURE WATER.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED PROPER UTENSIL STORAGE WITH THE PIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: OBSERVED CARDBOARD BEING USED THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PLEASE DO NOT USE CARDBOARD TO LINE SHELVES/FLOORS AS IT IS NOT NONABSORBENT OR DURABLE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED THE TWO-DOOR PREP TOP AT 54F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. MOST FOODS IN COOLER WERE COOLING OR NON-TCS. PIC MOVED ALL TCS FOODS TO WALK-IN. PLEASE ENSURE THIS COOLER IS NOT USED FOR TCS FOODS UNTIL IT IS REPAIRED AND CAN MAINTAIN TEMPERATURES BETWEEN 34-38F.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: BACK HANDWASHING SINK, COOK-LINE EQUIPMENT, INTERIOR (SHELVES, GASKETS) OF ALL REFRIGERATION UNITS AND FREEZERS IN NEED OF CLEANING.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THE ENTIRE BACK KITCHEN AND EQUIPMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS/WALLS THROUGHOUT THE BACK KITCHEN ARE IN NEED OF CLEANING DUE TO ACCUMULATION OF FOOD DEBRIS/GRIME.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE THOROUGHLY CLEAN THE ENTIRE BACK KITCHEN AND EQUIPMENT AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided

violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: raw chicken stored over raw pork in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC REARRANGED THE WALK IN COOLER TO PLACE THE PORK OVER THE CHICKEN.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: breaded cooked chicken 56F on the counter for 1 hr and cut cabbage 49F in the 2 Dr prep top
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC PLACED CHICKEN IM THE REFRIGERATOR AND AGREED TO KEEP IT REFRIGERATED. PIC DISCARDED CABBAGE.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: observed eggs stored at ambient (55F) for 1 hr.
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC PLACED EGGS IN THE WALK IN COOLER AND AGREED TO KEEP THEM REFRIGERATED.
